title: Apple Could Become a Multibillion-Dollar Ad Business. Here's How
text:
Text size
There could be an Amazon.com -style advertising business sitting inside Apple (ticker: AAPL).
While that possibility doesn’t seem to be driving the stock price right now, according to new research—that’s still down to iPhone sales and prices , writes Bernstein’s Toni Sacconaghi—it could be a long-term driver of big revenues and profits.
“Within just the last 2 years, Amazon’s (AMZN) $4 billion-$5 billion ad business has arguably become the third most significant driver for the stock—a remarkable transformation, considering that this ad business was effectively invisible to investors until last year,” Sacconaghi wrote Monday.
“Along similar lines (albeit to a lesser scale), we suspect that Apple’s (AAPL) ad business could ultimately reinforce the investor narrative of Apple’s high-margin Services growth, which remains one of the key bull theses for the stock,” he wrote.
Apple didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment. Newsletter Sign-up
Sacconaghi has a $200 price target on Apple stock, which is below Wall Street’s current average of $239, according to FactSet. (The shares were up 1% to about $220 in Monday morning trading.) He listed four reasons he’s bullish on advertising at Apple:
• Search ads in the App Store are worth about $500 million right now, according to Bernstein estimates. That could reach $2 billion by fiscal 2020, Sacconaghi wrote.
• A streaming-video business—widely rumored, potentially as part of an “ Apple bundle ”—could also yield substantial revenue. “An Apple streaming platform could have many times more users than Roku (ROKU) , and markedly higher average revenue per user due to Apple’s greater negotiating leverage vis-à-vis Google (GOOGL) and other content partners,” he says.
• Apple maps might also yield advertising opportunities not unlike Google’s product. Sacconaghi estimates that could be worth anything from about $3 billion a year to more like $100 billion. Recommended Reading
